purpose: Define Yume's zero-based four-tier creative escalation from fine-art intent through commercial production and tool R&D to proved partner/public showcase candidates.

tiers.title: Fine Art Development
tiers.purpose: protect artistic intent, source authorship, composition, drawing, color, form, visual language, experimentation, and editable masters before delivery constraints dominate

goddessSupport.reason: source identity, canon notes, artist credit, naming, provenance pointers and continuity

tiers.exit: escalate when the work needs reproducible delivery, campaign use, client-facing adaptation, or production constraints

tiers.title: Commercial Art Development
tiers.purpose: translate approved artistic intent into reproducible print, digital, motion, UI, campaign, game, and delivery-ready derivatives
tiers.exit: escalate when tooling, runtime, format, engine, automation, provider, or production-system questions require technical R&D

tiers.title: Creative Tool Research and Development
tiers.purpose: research, prototype, benchmark, and validate creative tools, Godot/Blender/GIMP/FFmpeg workflows, asset pipelines, providers, formats, shaders, automation, and runtime constraints
tiers.exit: escalate when one exact creative candidate is ready for proof packaging, partner showcase, or public-release review

tiers.title: Proved Showcase and Release Candidate
tiers.purpose: assemble one exact proof-backed creative package for partner demonstration or public-release consideration without confusing presentation quality with evidence
tiers.exit: Professor approval plus all required external publication/runtime receipts, or explicit blocker

parallelToTechnologyAudit.law: the ladders share escalation rhythm but not domain ownership
